title: Gate criterion draft and attestation proof
description: Manual browser/RPC proof. Uses the source UI, real credential authentication and existing receipt writers with isolated source/readiness fixtures. It does not publish a PR, start a worker or use a device. Requires an isolated Agent Chrome CDP endpoint and an unchanged prior source extraction with matching installed dependencies.

proofTargets.claim: Criterion text is visible before evidence loads and in the existing media review header.
Confirm, Skip and Undo update locally and survive an actual document reload with approval counts.
One approval records the exact notes in the existing attestation and the skip in the existing override receipt.
The prior source has no per-criterion confirmation action under the same browser and gateway fixture.

positive.intent: Confirm and skip real mounted rows, reload, undo and approve through existing RPCs.

positive-observed.intent: Require actual DOM observations, durable receipts and owned teardown.

control.intent: The same fixture on prior source has no confirmation action.

control-observed.intent: Require the causal control and clean resource teardown.
